GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 014.33 (4 Jun 47) GA
(SCAPIN - 1720)
APO 500
4 June 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Repatriation of Evacuees from Bonin Islands.
1. Reference is made to:
a. Memorandum for the Imperial Japanese Government, file and subject as above (SCAPIN 1048), dated 1 July 1946.
b. C.L.O. No. 3893(RF), subject as above, dated 23 May 1947.
2. Repatriation to the Bonin Islands, except for former residents of American and European descent, is still prohibited.
3. The request for temporary return of Japanese nationals to the Bonin Islands is not approved.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
